arStrings.szText:
Summon a Skeleton from a Corpse to fight for you.

If all of your Skeletons have been Summoned, {c_important}Raise Skeleton{/c} briefly Summons a Skeletal Priest to empower your {c_important}Minions{/c} for {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} seconds instead, increasing their damage by {c_number}[{SF_4} * 100|%x|]{/c} and healing them for {c_number}[{SF_3} * 100|%|]{/c} of their Maximum Life.
